name: gods-eye-view
description: A spy satellite simulator in your browser, except the data is real. Live open source spatial intelligence on a photorealistic 3D globe.
one_liner: A browser-based 3D globe showing real, live planes, ships, earthquakes, and traffic worldwide, that you can talk to like a voice assistant.
buyer: A news or explainer YouTuber who needs dramatic real-world footage without a camera crew or a stock-footage budget.
business_use_cases: A news YouTuber records live flyovers of a breaking event (wildfire, conflict zone, shipping blockade) for a video segment.
A logistics company builds a customer-facing dashboard showing live positions of its shipping fleet.
An educational creator makes geography or current-events explainer videos using real live global data as B-roll.

money_ideas.idea: Run a subscription 'stock footage' service selling recorded flyover clips of trending world events to news outlets and creators.
White-label the globe as a branded live-tracking dashboard for logistics or maritime clients.

steal_this: Record a daily 60-second 'what's happening on Earth right now' flyover and post it as a short-form video series this weekend.
